description: Self-hosted app for browsing movies, TV shows, anime, manga, live TV and sports from third-party sources, with a bundled local server.
pre_install: # Windows releases are NSIS portable stubs: unpack the embedded app-64.7z payload
if (!(Test-Path $stub)) { abort "Flyx portable installer '$stub' is missing." }
notes: Flyx keeps settings, accounts and logs in %LOCALAPPDATA%\flyx (not in the app directory). It also ships its own auto-updater; use 'scoop update flyx' to avoid version drift.
